statement: For the exact radial compactification and integer horizontal translation operator of C83-C84, an explicit continuous cutoff map on P times [1,infinity] agrees with the original map on each prescribed middle band, is the identity outside a finite band at every finite cutoff height, fixes the identity, and converges to the original map uniformly on compact actual families, including inverses. Every based sphere family therefore deforms to a fixed compact quotient-support family and has the exact C81 filling. All positive homotopy groups of this actual relative centralizer vanish.
depends_on: C83 exact radial coordinate and operator labels; C84 actual weighted topology, compact-family sublinearity and inverse comparison; Rado1923 original Jordan-parameter convergence theorem; explicit normalized conformal lift, bounded analytic difference, derivative cutoff, proper one-sheeted covering, boundary reparametrization, reflection and pasting proved here; C81 exact fixed compact quotient-support sphere filling
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), continuous actual cutoff and all positive homotopy groups for the specified radial discrete-cyclic model.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The source theorem is used only with its exact interior normalization and Frechet topology. The marked boundary rotation, continuous logarithm and all lift labels are established directly. The proper local homeomorphism has one sheet by a literal high-target preimage calculation. The original radial map-and-inverse topology is used at finite and infinite cutoff parameters.
computational_checks: The exact symbolic producer code/part_b/c85_parametric_cutoff_certificate.py and its adjacent JSON/stdout pass 145 exact checks of the cutoff polynomial and joins, derivative matrix, constants, displacement and tail bounds, exact translation/reflection labels and based homotopy faces. The conformal existence, parameter theorem application, covering, inverse continuity and sphere filling are proved analytically in the text.
notes: This completes all based sphere families, in every positive degree, for this actual radial cyclic operator action. It supplies a family-to-fixed-compact-support deformation without replacing the original compactification. No assertion of general discrete-operator contraction or of general C12 is made. C83's exact infinite evaluation path obstruction remains valid. Accepted earlier fragments are unchanged.
